name: Maite Delgado
scope: Dedicated Maite audit using the preserved dossier, real shared-engine fights and an independently opened native T3 preview tab. Only this report and tests/character-audits/maite.test.ts were written in the repository. No runtime/art edits, commits or child agents.
sourceRevision: 2273843fe788fb68bfa35d80d9ec87b48f1d2b7e; active game files are untracked working-tree content, so the hashes below identify the audited runtime more precisely than HEAD.

identityAndPortrayal.preservedDossier: Maite Coromoto Delgado de Mora is portrayed as the adult Venezuelan presenter and former beauty queen documented in the preserved dossier. The dossier ties the orange-red gown, long gloves, feather cape and microphone to Miss Venezuela 2022 and records adult editorial portraits from 2024.
identityAndPortrayal.visualObservation: The actual production atlas retains blonde shoulder-length layered hair, an adult oval face, a broad presenter smile, an orange-red gala dress, long gloves and feather cape. A microphone appears naturally in the greeting and several combat poses. The high kick and tucked jump are arcade adaptations already authorized by the dossier. No likeness or clothing replacement is justified by these inspected views.
identityAndPortrayal.audioLimit: The dossier includes older original select/win dialogue clips and provenance. This audit did not play or newly verify those clips and introduced no dialogue. The audit brief requires generic effort/pain reactions only for new combat reactions.

movementAndStance.walk: Starting x540 with rival x920, hold right24 calls: x644.0717109708025 and facing+1. Then hold left24 calls: x548.72800663896 and facing-1. Both player slots reproduce the same movement.
movementAndStance.jump: After releasing movement10 calls, first jump reaches y454.6 after10 calls. Second jump is accepted, third jump rejected. After100 further calls, grounded=true, y554, jumps0, stocks2 on both sides.
movementAndStance.combatSprites: Production loadSprite/drawSprite rendered and visually inspected all eight poses in both directions: microphone greeting0, guard1, run2/3, tucked jump4, punch/special5, high kick6 and recoil7. Heads, hands, gown, cape and shoes appear complete; no reversed run/attack or neighboring shoe fragments were observed.

atlas.note: Some component rectangles overlap the nominal row or column boundaries. The current production loader isolates overlapping silhouettes; the inspected jump/punch/kick/hurt views are clean. The older docs/sprite-qa.json does not contain a Maite row.

special.name: Luz de escenario
special.behavior: Stationary aimed spotlight. It creates no projectile, dash or teleport and checks one forward hit at attackTick15. The production renderer draws a triangular stage light centered in front of Maite, capped250 pixels from her position.
special.reproduction: Use createMatch('poliedro', Maite/Javier or mirrored order), advance the510-tick intro with empty inputs. Put Maite at x180 for side0 or x900 for side1, rival180 pixels forward, both at floor554 with energy100. Increment Maite special once and simulate100 calls. For front guard hold rival.block=true without movement; for rear guard also hold rival.right on side0 or rival.left on side1.
special.idle: Call15, simulation tick525: one hit, Javier HP84.5088, damage15.4912 =16*0.94*1.03. Both player sides agree. Maite stays at her original x and returns to no attack after recovery.
special.frontGuard: One block effect, Javier HP100 and Maite hits0 on both sides. Defender energy79.24 after100 calls including held-guard drain.
special.rearGuard: One hit at call15/tick525, HP84.5088, no block effects on both sides. The defender walks away and faces outward, so this guard correctly fails.
special.range: Forward gaps80,250 and299 each hit once on both player sides. Gaps300 and301 miss, matching the engine's strict less-than300 check. Moving the rival180 pixels behind Maite after attack activation makes the special miss on both sides.
special.vertical: With the rival jumping on the same call as Maite starts the special at gap180, the call15 spotlight connects on both sides; observed target y425.37/424.4 remains within its180-pixel vertical allowance. This technique is intentionally not marked groundOnly.
special.energyGate: Energy24 rejects special on both sides. At energy100, first call spends25 and leaves75 before hit rewards.

attacksAndCombos.light: At gap80 on either side, one hit for6.7774 damage leaves HP93.2226. Facing guard blocks it; target knockback points outward.
attacksAndCombos.heavy: At gap80 on either side, one hit for12.5866 damage leaves HP87.4134. Facing guard blocks it; target knockback points outward.
attacksAndCombos.base: Primera entrada (light→heavy), with real approach inputs after knockback, connects both strikes on both sides. Target HP77.546, heavy bonus3, elapsed65 simulation ticks.
attacksAndCombos.advanced: Cambio de cámara (light→light→heavy) with at least one win and real approach inputs connects all three strikes on both sides. Target HP66.6486, heavy bonus7, elapsed110 simulation ticks. At zero wins, the same input chain remains Primera entrada with bonus3.
attacksAndCombos.recognition: Input-chain naming includes whiffs by existing design. Separate gap140 probes whiff the lights and still recognize/buff heavy: HP84.3234 at zero wins and80.2034 at one win. Fully connected checks independently verify actual combo damage with chase inputs.
attacksAndCombos.definitive: Gran final requires at least three wins and75 energy. At gap200, call9 connects once for39.4696 damage: (28*0.94+12)*1.03, target HP60.5304 on both sides. Zero wins, two wins and three wins with74 energy reject it;75 and100 energy accept it. This is the shared close-range super with Maite's named finisher.

cpuFight.method: After510 intro ticks and setting gap420, leave Maite idle180 calls to exercise CPU offense, then use actual movement, guard, jump, light, heavy, spotlight and super inputs. Finish the full bout twice and deep-compare full state.
cpuFight.limitation: The CPU bout starts spotlight but it does not score a hit in that bout. The dedicated idle/front/rear and range fights separately prove spotlight collisions. This controller verifies an exercised complete fight, not character balance.

introAndSelection.name: Saludo de gala
introAndSelection.method: Opened a new native T3 tab with reuseExistingTab:false and passed this tabId to every subsequent preview call. Imported actual loadSprite/drawSprite/drawPresentation/renderMatch into temporary page canvases; no repository visual harness was written. Inspected both facings at intro and selection progress0/.29/.61/1 and later clamped1, plus the actual production cinematic at tick80 for player0 and tick260 for player1 and active spotlight after15 real engine calls.
introAndSelection.observation: The greeting lifts the microphone for a brief gala-host pose and returns to ready guard. Both mirrored cinematic panels face the rival, preserve the adult face and keep the microphone attached. Start and end use combat frame1. Intermediate samples maintain coherent hair, shoulders, gloves, cape and gown. The active spotlight is visible around the struck rival in both directions.
introAndSelection.oneShot: selectionProgress reaches1 at2800ms and remains1 at5600ms. Production drawPresentation selection images at progress1 and later clamped1 compare exactly equal. Portrait.tsx stops animation requests once progress reaches1. The actual engine accepts no movement/attack during the510-tick intro and faces the rival on either player side after completion.
introAndSelection.transientLimit: An early development reload cleared an imported page global, causing Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'a'); the following snapshot returned The page changed while capturing its snapshot. Reimporting and drawing within the same evaluation succeeded. Console history also records a brief Vite server connection loss/recovery. No new browser or server was started; this is an environment interruption rather than a Maite finding.
introAndSelection.limitations: Static representative interpolation samples and deterministic renderer scenes were reviewed. No audio playback or audiovisual synchronization was assessed, and every animation frame was not inspected.

recommendation: Retain Maite's current mechanics, likeness and presentation. No current reproducible Maite-specific bug from this focused audit requires a runtime change.
